POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Meena Pillai | Age: 44
Body Temperature at Scene: 18.4°C | Ambient Temperature: 30.3°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 15.4 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  2. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  3. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  4. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
